error.required: A room temperature sensor is required.
error.no_devices: Choose an air conditioner, one or more heating valves, or both.
error.own_entity: That is one of this integration's own thermostats — a room cannot drive itself. Choose the air conditioner's own entity.
error.not_a_heater: Only a heater this room drives can be marked as wired the other way round. Add it to Heating valves in this same form, or remove it from the inverted list.

devices.title: Sensors and devices
devices.description: Which sensors this room reads and which devices it drives. The temperature sensor is required; it is what the room is controlled against instead of the air conditioner's internal sensor. Normally-open actuators, which are energised to stop heat rather than to let it through. Leave empty unless a valve behaves backwards.

data.inverted_heaters: Heaters wired the other way round (must also be listed above)

cooling.name: Cooling
cooling.description: How the air conditioner is driven.

data.offset_correction: Correct the unit's setpoint for its sensor error

data_description.cooling_strategy: Pass-through forwards your setpoint and lets the unit regulate itself, which keeps an inverter modulating. Gated parks the unit low and starts and stops it against this room's sensor — use it where the unit sits in cabinetry and satisfies itself against its own cold air.
data_description.offset_correction: For a unit whose sensor is steadily wrong by a fixed amount. Never enable it for a unit inside cabinetry: there the error grows the longer it runs, and correcting for it feeds on itself.
data_description.parked_setpoint: Low enough that the unit can never satisfy itself while gated.
data_description.cool_min_on: How long the compressor must run once started. Protects it from the short cycling that gating would otherwise cause.
data_description.cool_min_off: How long it must rest before starting again.

heating.name: Heating
heating.description: How the valves are driven. Radiators settle in minutes; a floor slab keeps releasing heat for an hour, so it wants a wider band and much longer minimums.

data.allow_ac_heat: Heat this room with the air conditioner instead of the valves

data_description.allow_ac_heat: Either or, not both: when this is on the valves stay shut in this room.
data_description.heat_hot_tolerance: Usually larger than the starting tolerance, because a warm floor overshoots far more than it undershoots.
data_description.valve_travel: How long a thermal actuator takes to physically open. The room does not report a call for heat until this has elapsed, so a boiler never fires into a circuit that has not opened.

safety.name: Safety
safety.description: Applies whatever the thermostat is set to, including off.

data_description.frost_temperature: Below this the valves open regardless of mode, and keep heating until the room has recovered a degree past it.

sensor_lost.title: {room} has lost its temperature sensor
sensor_lost.description: {sensor} is unavailable, so {room} cannot be controlled against a reading. It has fallen back to warming through periodically so it cannot freeze, but it is no longer holding a temperature. Restore the sensor, or reconfigure the room to use a different one.
